text: 2026年7月份，全国居民消费价格同比上涨0.5%。其中，城市上涨0.5%，农村上涨0.4%；食品价格下降1.5%，非食品价格上涨0.9%；消费品价格上涨0.2%，服务价格上涨0.7%。1­­—7月平均，全国居民消费价格比上年同期上涨0.9%。
text_en: In July 2026, the national consumer prices rose 0.5% year-on-year. Among them, urban prices rose 0.5% and rural prices rose 0.4%; food prices fell 1.5% and non-food prices rose 0.9%; consumer goods prices rose 0.2% and service prices rose 0.7%. On average from January to July, national consumer prices rose 0.9% compared with the same period last year.
